what_it_does: An antioxidant used to help defend skin from oxidative stress and visible photoaging.
summary_short: Resveratrol is a plant-derived antioxidant best known in skincare for helping protect skin from oxidative stress linked to photoaging. Early skin-focused evidence is promising for wound healing, scarring, and UV-related aging, but stronger human cosmetic studies are still needed.
summary_long:
Resveratrol is a polyphenol found in grapes and red wine, used in skincare mainly for its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory potential. In skin, those properties may help reduce oxidative stress from UV exposure and environmental stressors, which are major contributors to visible photoaging.

A 2022 systematic review focused on wound healing, scarring, and skin aging found promising evidence that resveratrol may support wound repair, help counter excessive scarring, and protect against photoaging-related damage [PMID:unknown]. However, much of the evidence is still early-stage, so users should think of resveratrol as a supportive antioxidant ingredient rather than a proven stand-alone treatment for wrinkles, scars, or pigmentation.

Mechanistically, resveratrol appears to affect inflammation, cellular stress pathways, and oxidative damage. Broader biomedical research also suggests it can influence cell energy metabolism, which may help explain both its protective effects and why high exposures can behave differently depending on cell conditions [PMID:unknown].

For everyday skincare use, resveratrol is commonly paired with other antioxidants and barrier-supporting ingredients. It may appear alongside vitamin C, vitamin E, ferulic acid, niacinamide, or hydrating ingredients to broaden antioxidant support and improve cosmetic feel.

Safety-wise, resveratrol is generally used as a topical antioxidant, but antioxidant does not automatically mean irritation-free. Sensitive skin users should still patch test, especially in formulas that combine it with exfoliating acids, retinoids, or strong active blends.
quick_facts: Patch test if skin is sensitive
